text: I work at the airport and go through every day with no problems

author: Stephen Sprod
text:
I won't and nor will I put spares through the bag X-ray machines.  Abbott advise against it https://www.freestyle.abbott/uk-en/support/faq/question-answer.html?q=UKFaqquestion-71 
Metal detectors are fine.  
I carry laminated copies of the UK CAA medical device awareness card.
